name: Expert Apparel Manufacturing
old_description: Expert Apparel Manufacturing is a highly experienced and skilled Dallas-based garment manufacturer and development house specializing in the production of clothing and textile products.
about:
Expert Apparel Manufacturing is a Dallas, Texas-based garment manufacturer and development house that reports over 13 years of production experience. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The company provides end-to-end apparel manufacturing, handling fabric and accessory sourcing, pattern creation, sample development, bulk production, quality inspections, packaging, and shipping. Its Dallas factory runs a no-minimum production line capable of both small-batch and high-volume orders, serving categories from women's ready-to-wear and swimwear to athletic wear, menswear, luxury ready-to-wear, and childrenswear. EAM also offers rework services for brands producing overseas that need stateside correction of damaged or rejected goods.

EAM works with U.S.-based fashion brands ranging from startup labels to established companies, including those reshoring production from Asia and Europe. The company has assisted clients nationwide in launching and growing their collections, with a recent focus on luxury ready-to-wear and childrenswear segments. It also supports overseas-producing brands that require domestic rework on defective goods.

The company emphasizes its no-minimum policy, quick turnaround times, and all-in-house production as key differentiators from overseas factories. Its stated mission includes rebuilding the Dallas-Fort Worth garment manufacturing base, advocating for domestic production, and improving worker wages and conditions. EAM also highlights ethical quality control, sustainability efforts such as waste reduction and fabric recycling, and a partnership approach to each project.
